thread:
lena: Quick check — AWS Marketplace listing go-live target is 2026-05-10. We need the SOC2 one-page summary, final pen-test artifacts, and the vendor questionnaire completed. Who owns what and can we lock deadlines?

omar: I can own the SOC2 summary + attestations. Need signed auditor PDF (scoped summary, not raw evidence) by 2026-04-20. Also we need the formal attestation statement for the marketplace listing. :+1:

mika: For artifact ingestion, ops will presign S3 links (7d TTL). Please use the evidence path format so ingestion lambda picks it up: 

```
s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/{partner}/{artifact_type}/{YYYYMMDD}-{filename}.pdf
# example
s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/acme-si/soc2/20260415-acme-soc-summary.pdf
```

mika: We'll also need a small JSON manifest with owner/email and redaction flag for each file. I'll drop a template.

nuan: Nuan (Acme SI) here — we can run the pen-test witness window remotely. Proposed week: 2026-04-25 to 2026-04-29. We'll hand over runbook + redaction matrix by 2026-04-08. Who signs off on observer list?

sarah: Legal — NDA addendum needed for live witness sessions (external observers). Send the list of observer emails and intended scopes, I can fast-track. Also we require the marketing blurb for the listing to avoid claims about compliance scope.

compliance-bot: Heads up — marketplace questionnaire v3 must be submitted before artifact upload. Form: https://docs.redwood.com/marketplace/questionnaire-v3. Required sections: scope, data flow diagram (png/pdf), audit contacts.

lena: Proposed owners: Omar = SOC2 summary & attestation, Nuan = pen-test coordination & runbook, Mika = presigns + manifest ingestion, Sarah = NDAs/legal signoff. Can everyone ack and confirm their hard deadline? Also need a 1-page SOC summary for the listing page (public-friendly).

omar: ack — deadline for signed auditor summary 2026-04-20. I'll produce the 1-pager draft by 2026-04-18.

nuan: ack — runbook + redaction matrix by 2026-04-08; pen-test witness week fine. Observer list: send to me and Sarah by 2026-04-05.

mika: ack — presign infra ready. Please name files exactly per path above. I need manifests uploaded to `s3://redwood-marketplace/manifests/pending/` by 2026-04-22 so we can QA before publishing.

sarah: ack — NDA addendum draft will be in Slack by 2026-04-06. Marketing blurb: please provide single paragraph + approved compliance bullet points by 2026-04-18.

lena: Plan for announcement cadence: internal beta 2026-05-03, public 2026-05-10. To hit that, final evidences must be in place by 2026-04-22 (ingest + QA). If anything slips we push soft launch back.

omar: noted — I'll flag blockers early. If auditors delay, we fallback to a "pending attestation" note but must clear before public launch.

nuan: question — do we need a witnessed pen-test recording stored? we prefer ephemeral screen share + signed witness attestation rather than raw recording. Thoughts?

sarah: legal prefers attestation + logs (no raw recordings). We'll accept signed witness statement and timestamped test logs. Add that requirement to the manifest template.

mika: added — manifest will include `witness_attestation: true|false` and `log_path` fields.

lena: Thanks team. I'll create a short checklist and owners doc and ping everyone tomorrow with final dates. :eyes:

mika: leaving a quick command for presigners (ops):

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/acme-si/soc2/20260415-acme-soc-summary.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
mika: tagging @compliance-bot to validate questionnaire after upload.

compliance-bot: Received. Will run automated validation after manifest upload and post a pass/fail in this thread.
